PATH_NOT_FOUND: The selected directory does not exist. It may have been moved or deleted.
NOT_A_DIRECTORY: The selected path is not a directory and cannot be imported as a TeamCow project.
PATH_NOT_READABLE: The selected directory is currently inaccessible.
GIT_NOT_INSTALLED: This directory does not have Git enabled, and no git command is available on the system.
GIT_INIT_FAILED: Git initialization failed. TeamCow did not write the project record.
GIT_STATUS_PARSE_FAILED: Git status returned output TeamCow could not parse.
GIT_CHANGES_READ_FAILED: TeamCow could not read the current worktree changes.
GIT_CHANGE_OPERATION_FAILED: TeamCow could not update the selected worktree changes.
GIT_COMMIT_EMPTY_INDEX: There are no staged changes to commit.
GIT_COMMIT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Git cannot use the configured commit identity.
GIT_COMMIT_REJECTED: Git or a repository hook rejected the commit.
GIT_COMMIT_FAILED: TeamCow could not commit the staged changes.
DUPLICATE_PROJECT: This project has already been imported.
PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: The project does not exist. It may have been removed.
CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: The conversation does not exist. It may have been removed.
CONVERSATION_SELECTION_FAILED: The execution environment bound to this conversation is missing.
CONVERSATION_RENAME_FAILED: TeamCow could not rename the conversation.
CONVERSATION_DELETE_FAILED: TeamCow could not delete the conversation.
CONVERSATION_RUN_IN_PROGRESS: This conversation already has a provider run in progress.
PROVIDER_NOT_READY: The selected provider is not ready.
WORKTREE_NOT_FOUND: The selected execution target could not be found.
WORKTREE_BRANCH_EXISTS: A worktree for this branch already exists in the project.
WORKTREE_PATH_EXISTS: The target directory for the new worktree already exists.
WORKTREE_CREATE_FAILED: TeamCow could not create the new git worktree.
WORKTREE_IN_USE: This worktree is still required by the project.
WORKTREE_DELETE_FAILED: TeamCow could not delete the git worktree.
HANDOFF_EDITOR_NOT_SELECTED: Choose a coding editor before opening files or worktrees.
HANDOFF_EDITOR_UNAVAILABLE: The selected coding editor is not available on this Mac.
HANDOFF_TARGET_NOT_FILE: The selected handoff target is not a file.
HANDOFF_OPEN_FAILED: TeamCow could not open the selected target in the selected editor.
HANDOFF_PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKTREE: TeamCow refused to open a path outside the conversation worktree.
FILE_PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKTREE: TeamCow refused to access a file outside the conversation worktree.
FILE_NOT_READABLE: The selected file cannot be read.
FILE_NOT_WRITABLE: The selected file cannot be saved.
FILE_BINARY: This file appears to be binary and cannot be edited inside TeamCow.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large to open in TeamCow.
FILE_SAVE_CONFLICT: The file changed on disk before TeamCow saved your edit.
FILE_RUN_ACTIVE_READONLY: The provider is currently running, so this file is read-only.
FILE_READ_FAILED: TeamCow could not read the selected file.
FILE_WRITE_FAILED: TeamCow could not save the selected file.
EXTERNAL_OPEN_APP_UNAVAILABLE: The selected local app is not available.
EXTERNAL_OPEN_FAILED: TeamCow could not open the current location in the selected app.
TERMINAL_NATIVE_MODULE_FAILED: Terminal support is unavailable in this build.
NOTIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: System notifications are unavailable on this Mac.
NOTIFICATION_SEND_FAILED: TeamCow could not send the system notification.
UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: TeamCow could not check for updates.
UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: TeamCow could not restart to install the update.
suggestion.PATH_NOT_FOUND: Please select a local project directory that still exists.
suggestion.NOT_A_DIRECTORY: Please select a local project folder, not a single file.
suggestion.PATH_NOT_READABLE: Please check the read permissions of the directory and try again.
suggestion.GIT_NOT_INSTALLED: Please install Git first, then re-import the directory.
suggestion.GIT_INIT_FAILED: Please confirm that git can execute normally in the directory and try again.
suggestion.GIT_STATUS_PARSE_FAILED: Please check the repository state in a terminal and refresh Git status. This is a local Git integration issue, not provider or network unavailability.
suggestion.GIT_CHANGES_READ_FAILED: Check the repository state in Terminal, then refresh Changes.
suggestion.GIT_CHANGE_OPERATION_FAILED: Refresh Changes, review the current file state, then try the Git action again.
suggestion.GIT_COMMIT_EMPTY_INDEX: Stage at least one change, then commit again.
suggestion.GIT_COMMIT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Configure a valid Git user.name and user.email, then retry without changing the staged set.
suggestion.GIT_COMMIT_REJECTED: Review the Git or hook output, address the repository requirement, then retry without changing the staged set.
suggestion.GIT_COMMIT_FAILED: Review the Git error, commit identity, and hooks, then retry without changing the staged set.
suggestion.PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: Please refresh the project list or re-import the project.
suggestion.CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: Please refresh the project list or create a new conversation.
suggestion.CONVERSATION_SELECTION_FAILED: Please re-import the project and try again.
suggestion.CONVERSATION_RENAME_FAILED: Please try a different title or refresh the project list.
suggestion.CONVERSATION_DELETE_FAILED: Please refresh the project list and try again.
suggestion.CONVERSATION_RUN_IN_PROGRESS: Stop the current run before sending another message or changing the model.
suggestion.PROVIDER_NOT_READY: Refresh provider readiness, complete the provider setup, then try again.
suggestion.WORKTREE_NOT_FOUND: Please re-open the launcher and choose a valid execution target.
suggestion.WORKTREE_BRANCH_EXISTS: Choose a different branch name or reuse the existing worktree.
suggestion.WORKTREE_PATH_EXISTS: Remove or rename the conflicting directory, then try again.
suggestion.WORKTREE_CREATE_FAILED: Please check the git error details and confirm the repository can create worktrees.
suggestion.WORKTREE_IN_USE: Keep the worktree while it is the default target or bound to existing conversations.
suggestion.WORKTREE_DELETE_FAILED: Please check the git error details and resolve local changes before trying again.
suggestion.HANDOFF_EDITOR_NOT_SELECTED: Open Settings and select an installed coding editor.
suggestion.HANDOFF_EDITOR_UNAVAILABLE: Open Settings and choose another installed coding editor.
suggestion.HANDOFF_TARGET_NOT_FILE: Choose a changed file, or open the whole worktree instead.
suggestion.HANDOFF_OPEN_FAILED: Please confirm the selected editor can open the path, then try again.
suggestion.HANDOFF_PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKTREE: Open files from the current conversation worktree only.
suggestion.FILE_PATH_OUTSIDE_WORKTREE: Open files from the current conversation worktree only.
suggestion.FILE_NOT_READABLE: Check file permissions or open the file in an external editor.
suggestion.FILE_NOT_WRITABLE: Check file permissions or save the changes in an external editor.
suggestion.FILE_BINARY: Use Open in editor to inspect or edit this file externally.
suggestion.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Use Open in editor for large files.
suggestion.FILE_SAVE_CONFLICT: Reload from disk, overwrite, or keep editing after reviewing the conflict.
suggestion.FILE_RUN_ACTIVE_READONLY: Wait for the provider run to finish before saving manual edits.
suggestion.FILE_READ_FAILED: Refresh Files or open the file externally.
suggestion.FILE_WRITE_FAILED: Check local permissions and try saving again.
suggestion.EXTERNAL_OPEN_APP_UNAVAILABLE: Choose another installed app from the Open Location menu.
suggestion.EXTERNAL_OPEN_FAILED: Confirm the app can open this worktree, then try again.
suggestion.TERMINAL_SHELL_UNAVAILABLE: Check your shell path and try again.
suggestion.TERMINAL_START_FAILED: Try reopening the terminal from the inspected conversation.
suggestion.TERMINAL_NATIVE_MODULE_FAILED: Rebuild native dependencies and try again.
suggestion.NOTIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: Check macOS notification settings. This does not affect local projects or conversation history.
suggestion.NOTIFICATION_SEND_FAILED: Check macOS notification settings and continue using the local workspace.
suggestion.UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Try again later or verify release metadata for this build.
suggestion.UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: Restart TeamCow manually after confirming the update was downloaded.
